description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAllowedSkillModel class in the OrangeHRM project. It models a skill associated with an employee, serving as an API data transfer object (DTO) with serialization features. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for model serialization, encapsulating the Skill entity and exposing its 'id' and 'name' properties for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillModel
classes.description: Data transfer object for employee skills in the OrangeHRM API, enabling serialization of Skill entity with 'id' and 'name' properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Skill entity and sets up property filters for serialization.
